links.outcome: Fit of a general lung-texture tool to tuberculosis HRCT, including cavity classification
links.effect: The software has no dedicated cavity class. Tuberculous cavities and post-destructive abnormalities were frequently labeled as emphysema. The abstract reports no quantitative error rate.
links.quote: As a result, emphysema-labeled low-attenuation areas should not be interpreted as conventional emphysema alone, because tuberculous cavities and post-destructive abnormalities were frequently included in this category.

unlisted_practices: AI-assisted quantitative HRCT analysis for longitudinal monitoring of treatment response in tuberculosis

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of commercial AI software (AVIEW Lung Texture) to quantify longitudinal HRCT changes in pulmonary tuberculosis patients.
